source: Things to do in Raleigh this Weekend! — Thingstodo919

events.name: GalaxyCon Raleigh
events.tagline: A four-day festival of fandom takes over downtown Raleigh with celebrities, cosplay, comics, gaming, and fan events.
events.description: GalaxyCon Raleigh runs July 23-26, 2026 at the Raleigh Convention Center and features celebrities, artists, writers, voice actors, cosplayers, entertainers, creators, wrestlers, and panelists. Friday hours are 10 a.m. to 1 a.m., with the exhibit hall open 10 a.m. to 8 p.m.

events.name: Art Heist Dinner: The Mystery of History
events.tagline: A mystery-themed dinner at NCMA exploring the untold stories behind the exhibition *Knowing the West*.
events.description: Art Heist Dinner: The Mystery of History is a special dinner event at the North Carolina Museum of Art in Raleigh. It is scheduled for Friday, July 24, 2026, from 6–9 PM and is tied to the museum's exhibition *Knowing the West*.

events.name: Ella Langley: The Dandelion Tour
events.tagline: Ella Langley brings her Dandelion Tour to Cary with special guests Kaitlyn Butts and Laci Kaye Booth.
events.description: Ella Langley headlines Koka Booth Amphitheatre in Cary on Friday, July 24, 2026, as part of The Dandelion Tour. The show is listed for 7:00 PM and includes special guests Kaitlyn Butts and Laci Kaye Booth.

events.name: Elmiene - Sounds for Someone Tour
events.tagline: Elmiene brings his Sounds for Someone Tour to The Ritz in Raleigh on Friday night.
events.description: Elmiene's Sounds for Someone Tour is scheduled for Friday, July 24, 2026 at The Ritz in Midtown Raleigh. The event is listed for 7:00 PM with tickets starting at $63+.

events.name: Desi Banks: Your Favorite Cousin Tour
events.tagline: Desi Banks brings his stand-up tour to Raleigh Improv for a weekend of late-summer comedy.
events.description: Stand-up comedy show by Desi Banks at Raleigh Improv in Cary. The event is part of a three-day run from July 24–26, 2026, with Friday performances at 7:00 PM and 9:15 PM.

events.name: Steve Furey
events.tagline: Steve Furey brings a Friday-night stand-up set to Room 861 at Goodnights Comedy Club.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 7:30 and 9:45 PM · Sat 7:30 and 10:00 PM · Sun 7:30 PM
events.description: Steve Furey is scheduled to perform at Room 861 at Goodnights Comedy Club in Raleigh over the July 24-26 weekend. Listed showtimes are Friday 7:30 and 9:45 PM, Saturday 7:30 and 10:00 PM, and Sunday 7:30 PM.

events.name: IAMDYNAMITE
events.tagline: An outdoor live-music performance on NC State’s Centennial Campus.
events.description: IAMDYNAMITE is listed as part of NC State Centennial Campus Placemaking’s Artist Notes 2026 programming in Raleigh. The provided event listing indicates a Friday appearance, but does not include a full public schedule or exact street address.

events.name: Hillsborough St Makers & Music
events.tagline: A free summer evening of live music, local shopping, and community fun in Compiegne Park.
events.description: A summer series event at Compiegne Park featuring live music, local vendors, family-friendly activities, and lawn games. Attendees are encouraged to bring food and drinks from Hillsborough Street businesses and enjoy them in the park.

events.name: Single Mingle
events.tagline: A 21+ summer singles mixer with camp-themed fun at Downtown Cary Park.
events.venue: DCP Nest and The Splash Pad
events.description: Downtown Cary Park hosts Single Mingle on Friday, July 24, 2026, from 7 to 10 p.m. The 21+ event features a camp-themed singles mixer with a gourmet s'mores bar, live DJ, and classic camp games.

events.name: ADF Presents: Pilobolus
events.tagline: Pilobolus brings its 2026 ADF program to Page Auditorium for one Friday night performance and a Saturday encore.
events.description: American Dance Festival presents Pilobolus at Page Auditorium at Duke in Durham. The program runs 115 minutes including one intermission and is ticketed through Duke University’s Box Office.

events.name: Square Dance Social at Dix Park
events.tagline: A free summer evening of square dancing, music, and easy partner dances at Dix Park.
events.venue: Gipson Play Plaza at Dix Park
events.description: Dix Park hosts a square dance social at Gipson Play Plaza with an instructor leading square dances and easy partner dances. No experience is needed, and the event runs from 6:00 to 8:00 PM.

events.name: Na'im Lynn
events.tagline: A two-show Friday night of sharp stand-up at Goodnights.
events.description: Na'im Lynn is scheduled for two Friday shows at Goodnights Comedy Club in Raleigh on July 24, 2026. The listed showtimes are 7:00 PM and 9:15 PM.

events.name: 2026 NASCAR Regional Season - Capital Chevrolet 190
events.tagline: Short-track stock car racing under the lights at Raleigh’s local bullring.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 6 PM gates · 7:20 PM qualifying · 8:30 PM racing
events.freeNote: Adults: $18; Seniors/Military/Students: $15; Children 12 and under: Free
events.description: A NASCAR Regional Season race held at Wake County Speedway in Raleigh. The track lists Friday night gates at 6 pm, qualifying at 7:20 pm, and racing at 8:30 pm.

events.name: Carolina CryptidCon Tour - Mermaids to Mothman
events.tagline: A two-day cryptid and oddities festival packed with vendors, entertainment, and family fun.
events.venue: Jim Graham Building at North Carolina State Fairgrounds
events.description: Carolina CryptidCon Tour: Mermaids to Mothman is a two-day Raleigh event featuring cryptids, folklore, oddities, curiosities, and craft vendors. The lineup also includes roaming entertainment, live music, an adults-only magic show, a beer garden, and a kids zone.

events.name: Let It Happen: Tame Impala Dance Party
events.tagline: A late-night dance party celebrating Tame Impala and psych-pop favorites.
events.freeNote: Tickets were listed at $19.90; online sales may be closed
events.description: Let It Happen is a Tame Impala dance party at Motorco Music Hall in Durham, featuring DJ Uniq playing Tame Impala and related psychedelic rock, pop, and indie-electronic tracks. The event is listed for Friday, July 24 at 8:30 PM.

events.name: Downtown Raleigh Restaurant Week
events.tagline: A downtown dining celebration with special prix-fixe menus and deals.
events.freeNote: Prix-fixe and special menus vary by restaurant
events.description: Downtown Raleigh Restaurant Week runs July 16–26, 2026 and features participating downtown restaurants, cafés, bars, bakeries, and breweries offering prix-fixe dinners, lunch specials, drink specials, desserts, and discounts. The event is organized by the Downtown Raleigh Alliance and includes many downtown venues.

events.name: Riot! at the Disco : Emo + Pop Punk Nite
events.tagline: A late-night emo and pop-punk dance party at Stanczyks.
events.description: Riot! at the Disco : Emo + Pop Punk Nite is scheduled for Friday, July 24 at Stanczyks in Durham from 8:30 to 11:00 PM. The event is described as a night inspired by emo and pop-punk music.

events.name: Automag
events.tagline: A Friday night rock bill at Lincoln Theatre with Automag, Strychnine Soul, and The Locks.
events.description: Automag appears on the Lincoln Theatre schedule for Friday, July 24, 2026, with Strychnine Soul and The Locks. Doors open at 7 PM and the show starts at 8 PM.

events.name: M. Roomie with Bucko, Melodramatic, Fake Jr.
events.tagline: A Friday night indie rock bill at KINGS in downtown Raleigh.
events.description: M. Roomie plays with Bucko, Melodramatic, and Fake Jr. at KINGS in downtown Raleigh. The event is listed for Friday at the venue's Upper Level space.

events.name: Live Execution of Meow2
events.tagline: An underground electronic performance night with a theatrical fake execution centerpiece.
events.description: An experimental multi-act electronic and underground performance celebrating the one-year anniversary of the MEOW2 project in collaboration with Mono Feo. The lineup includes psychedelic electronic, clown gabber, a fake execution performance of MEOW2, and closing techno and ambient sets.

events.name: Cleophus James
events.tagline: A Friday night live-music set at Slim’s Dive Bar in downtown Raleigh.
events.description: Cleophus James is scheduled to perform at Slim’s Dive Bar in downtown Raleigh on Friday, July 24, 2026. The listing shows the set time as 9:00–11:00 PM.

events.name: Tributes to Pearl Jam & Rage Against The Machine: feat. Deep 6 & War Within A Breath
events.tagline: A night of grunge and rap-rock tributes at The Pour House.
events.venue: The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop
events.description: Deep 6 performs a tribute to Pearl Jam, and War Within A Breath pays tribute to Rage Against the Machine. The show is scheduled for Friday, July 24 at The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop in Raleigh.

events.name: Caitlin Krisko and The Broadcast
events.tagline: Soul-rock from Asheville brings a free live set to Bay 7.
events.description: Caitlin Krisko and The Broadcast is a soul-rock band from Asheville, North Carolina. The performance at Bay 7 in Durham is listed as a free indoor live music event.

events.name: Sapphics Unity Night
events.tagline: A 21+ sapphic community night at Bitter Social in downtown Raleigh.
events.description: Sapphics Unity Night is a social gathering hosted by the LGBT Center of Raleigh at Bitter Social. It is scheduled for Friday, July 24, 2026, from 8 PM to midnight and is listed as a 21+ event.

events.name: Ally J—Blues, R&B, Jazz, Funk
events.tagline: A Friday afternoon set of blues, R&B, jazz, and funk at Succotash.
events.description: Live performance by Ally J featuring blues, R&B, jazz, and funk at Succotash Southern & Creole Kitchen in Durham. The listing shows a Friday, July 24, 2026 afternoon set from 3:00 to 5:00 PM, with reservations recommended.

events.name: Independent Study at TBL
events.tagline: A beginner-friendly, drop-in self-guided art session at The Bike Library.
events.freeNote: Free admission; no tickets are necessary
events.description: Join a drop-in self-guided art experience with options like watercolor, charcoal, oil, pastel, or collage. The event is beginner friendly and all supplies are provided.

events.name: Clue (High School Edition)
events.tagline: A teen cast brings the classic murder mystery to the stage with fast-paced comedy and suspense.
events.description: Raleigh Little Theatre presents Clue (High School Edition) at the Gaddy-Goodwin Teaching Theatre from July 24 to August 9, 2026. The production runs about 90 minutes and is performed Fridays and Saturdays at 7:30 PM and Sundays at 3:00 PM.

events.name: Newsies Jr.
events.tagline: Burning Coal Theatre Company’s youth summer production brings Disney’s fast-paced newsroom musical to the stage.
events.description: Burning Coal Theatre Company’s Summer Theatre Conservatory is presenting Disney’s Newsies Jr. for ages 12–19. Performances are scheduled for July 24 and 25, 2026 at Murphey School Auditorium in Raleigh.

events.name: Sunset Sound Bath
events.tagline: An outdoor sunset sound healing session for relaxation and reset.
events.description: A ticketed sunset sound bath hosted at The Honeysuckle Tea House in Chapel Hill. The event is listed for Friday during the weekend of July 24, 2026.

events.name: The Pickle Days of Summer
events.tagline: A weeklong pickle party with food, drinks, games, and a field-day finale.
events.scheduleNote: Fri July 24–Sat July 25; daily July 20–26, with Field Day Finale on Sat 12–5 PM
events.description: Bull City Burger & Brewery’s Pickle Days of Summer runs July 20–26, 2026, featuring pickle-inspired food and drinks, daily games and giveaways, trivia, and family activities. The event includes a Pickle Days Field Day Finale on Saturday, July 25.

events.name: Holly Springs Salamanders vs. Yorktown Coconuts
events.tagline: A Friday night home game at North Main Athletic Complex.
events.description: Home baseball game for the Holly Springs Salamanders against the Yorktown Coconuts at North Main Athletic Complex in Holly Springs. The listed start time is 6:30 PM.

events.name: North Carolina Courage vs. Utah Royals
events.tagline: NWSL action at WakeMed Soccer Park as the Courage host Utah.
events.description: North Carolina Courage host Utah Royals FC in a regular-season NWSL match at WakeMed Soccer Park in Cary. The match is scheduled for Saturday, July 25, 2026, with kickoff at 5:45 p.m. MT.

events.name: CaryLIVE! Suitcase Junket
events.tagline: Free summer concert at Downtown Cary Park featuring The Suitcase Junket.
events.description: CaryLIVE! is a free outdoor concert series at Downtown Cary Park. The Suitcase Junket performs at the DCP Great Lawn Pavilion on Saturday, July 25, 2026, from 7:30 to 9:30 p.m.

events.name: Notes on View: Lynnette Barber and Will Ellis Blues Duo
events.tagline: Free live blues music in the museum gallery.
events.description: A free gallery performance by Lynnette Barber and Will Ellis at the North Carolina Museum of Art. Seating is limited and available first-come, first-served.

events.name: Matt Maeson: Watch My Step Tour
events.tagline: Matt Maeson brings his Watch My Step Tour to Raleigh for a Saturday night at The Ritz.
events.description: Matt Maeson is scheduled to perform at The Ritz in Raleigh on Saturday, July 25, 2026 as part of his Watch My Step Tour. The show is listed as an indoor club concert with tickets available through the venue and third-party ticket sources.

events.name: Juggling Record-Breaking Attempt
events.tagline: Watch a professional juggler try to break a world record at Pullen Park.
events.scheduleNote: Sat 2–4 PM · Record attempt at 3:30 PM
events.description: Professional juggler Chris “Juggleboy” Fowler will attempt to break the record for catching five full-sized baseball bats the greatest number of times in one minute. The free event takes place at the Pullen Park event stage and is open to all ages.

events.name: World Series of Armwrestling
events.tagline: Watch the Southern Regional qualifiers bring high-energy armwrestling action to Cary.
events.description: The World Series of Armwrestling Southern Regional qualifiers take place at Sports & Social in Cary on Saturday, July 25, with weigh-ins the day before for participants. The event is free and open to the public, and children are welcome.

events.name: Dominant Championship Wrestling
events.tagline: Live pro wrestling at The Fruit in Durham.
events.description: DCW Presents FORBIDDEN is a live pro wrestling event at The Fruit in Durham on Saturday, July 25, 2026. The listing shows a 7:00–9:30 PM show time and ticketed admission.

events.name: 46th Crape Myrtle Festival Grand Gala presents A Royal Affair: The Queens Reveal Gala
events.tagline: A royal-themed fundraiser celebrating the reveal of the Queens for the 46th Crape Myrtle Festival.
events.description: The Crape Myrtle Festival’s Grand Gala is scheduled for Saturday, July 25, 2026, at Tempo by Hilton Raleigh Downtown. The event runs from 7 to 10 PM and is listed with admission priced at $50–$80.

events.name: Caffeine & Machines Monthly Car Show Series
events.tagline: A free monthly morning car meet with 200+ rides at Triangle Town Center.
events.description: Caffeine & Machines is a recurring monthly outdoor car show held at Triangle Town Center in North Raleigh. It features a wide mix of cars and is open to all makes and models.

events.name: Candlelight: The Best of Hans Zimmer
events.tagline: A candlelit live-music tribute to Hans Zimmer’s film scores.
events.scheduleNote: Select your date/time in the ticket selector · 60 minutes
events.freeNote: Tickets sold separately; pricing not listed
events.description: Candlelight: The Best of Hans Zimmer is a 60-minute live concert experience at The Rialto in Raleigh. Audience members must be age 8 or older, and doors open 45 minutes before showtime.

events.name: Damion Rashad — Summer Concert Series
events.tagline: Free summer live music in Forest Hills Park.
events.description: Durham Parks and Recreation’s Summer Concert Series features a free, family-friendly evening of live music at Forest Hills Park. The July 25 performance is listed as Damion Rashad & Friends.

events.name: BIKES, BURGERS & BREWS
events.tagline: A motorcycle meetup with food and beer at Tobacco Road Harley-Davidson.
events.description: This event is listed for Tobacco Road Harley-Davidson in Raleigh and appears to combine bikes, burgers, and brews. The provided listing does not include a specific start time or address.

events.name: Sip & Shred
events.tagline: Free skate competition with food, water, and prizes at Durham Skatepark.
events.description: Sip & Shred is a free community skate event at Durham Skatepark with youth competition, Game of S.K.A.T.E., best trick contests, prizes, free food, and free water. The listing says everyone is welcome.

events.name: Intro to Art Entrepreneurship
events.tagline: Turn artistic passion into a thriving business in this practical workshop.
events.description: A workshop led by freelance artist and illustrator David Anyanwu, also known as P-Shinobi. It focuses on practical steps for turning artistic skills into a business.

events.name: Horror Book Club “Butter”
events.tagline: A free Saturday horror book club discussion of *Butter* at Chapel of Bones.
events.description: Horror Book Club “Butter” is a free in-person discussion meeting at Chapel of Bones in Raleigh. The listed discussion time is Saturday at 10:00 AM, and attendees are asked to read the book and show up.

events.name: Newbreed Raleigh Summer Championship
events.tagline: Youth and adult jiu-jitsu competitors meet at the State Fairgrounds for a family-friendly summer tournament.
events.venue: Kerr Scott Building at North Carolina State Fairgrounds
events.description: A Newbreed Jiu Jitsu Federation tournament held at the Kerr Scott Building at the North Carolina State Fairgrounds in Raleigh. The event is listed for Saturday, July 25, 2026, with competitors ranging from young children to adults.

events.name: Steam Shop Saturday at New Hope Valley Railway
events.tagline: See the steam crew at work and ride the rails while supporting the restoration of engine #17.
events.venue: North Carolina Railway Museum & New Hope Valley Railway
events.scheduleNote: Sat 10:00 AM–1:30 PM · train rides 10:30 AM and 12:00 PM
events.description: Steam Shop Saturday is a special New Hope Valley Railway event on Saturday, July 25, 2026, with the steam crew onsite answering questions and sharing behind-the-scenes insight into steam locomotive operation. The event includes train rides during the late morning and early afternoon, and ticket sales support restoration of #17.

events.name: ADF Children's Matinee: Pilobolus
events.tagline: A family-friendly dance matinee with Pilobolus at ADF.
events.freeNote: Admission $18; $30 for both when you buy tickets to both shows
events.description: Pilobolus Children's Matinee is part of the American Dance Festival at Page Auditorium at Duke. The program is 60 minutes with no intermission and is recommended for ages 3+.

events.name: Dirty South Rodeo Festival
events.tagline: A summer rodeo and festival with live action, food, and carnival-style entertainment.
events.description: Dirty South Rodeo Festival is scheduled for Saturday, July 25, 2026 at Gooch Sports Arena in Wendell. The event runs from 3:00 PM to 8:00 PM and features rodeo action along with carnival vibes, live performances, food vendors, and family-friendly attractions.

events.name: Christmas in July 2026
events.tagline: A festive summer celebration with QDR, prizes, and holiday shopping at Waverly Place.
events.description: Celebrate Christmas in July with QDR and Waverly Place. The event features a prize wheel, surprise offers from shops, and the GRL Pop-Up Market with women-owned brands.

events.name: Staged Reading of 'The American Revolution' by Kirk Wood Bromley
events.tagline: A free Triangle staged reading of Kirk Wood Bromley’s verse play features James Urbaniak as George Washington.
events.description: Social Animal Theater and SEVEN present a free staged reading of Kirk Wood Bromley’s "The American Revolution" in Raleigh. The event is scheduled for Saturday, July 25, 2026, at 8 PM and features a cast drawn largely from Triangle artists.

events.name: Closing Reception | Artifacts: Storytelling Through Material Forms Exhibition
events.tagline: Celebrate the final day of the exhibition with the artists at Pullen Arts Center.
events.freeNote: Free and open to the public
events.description: A closing reception for Artifacts: Storytelling Through Material Forms at Pullen Arts Center. Guests can view the exhibition, meet the artists, and enjoy a community gathering before the show closes.

events.name: 7 Years of Good Times: Customer Appreciation Party at The Davie
events.tagline: An all-day anniversary party with free food, drink specials, and prize giveaways.
events.description: The Davie is hosting a Customer Appreciation Party to celebrate seven years in business. The event features free food from Parkside Restaurant, hourly prize giveaways, and drink specials throughout the day.

events.name: 90’s & 2000’s Throwback Night with Andrew Hypes
events.tagline: A nostalgic night of 90s and 2000s throwback music at KINGS.
events.description: KINGS in Raleigh is hosting a throwback night featuring Andrew Hypes with music centered on the 1990s and 2000s. The event is listed for Saturday on the venue’s show page.

events.name: Hank, Pattie, and the Current
events.tagline: Progressive bluegrass with soulful twists of Motown, jazz, and pop.
events.description: Hank, Pattie, and the Current is a North Carolina-based progressive bluegrass band led by banjo player Hank Smith and fiddler/vocalist Pattie Hopkins Kinlaw. The group blends traditional bluegrass with influences from classical, Motown, jazz, and pop.

events.name: Chris Acker / Creekbed Carter Hogan
events.tagline: An intimate Saturday night set of country-folk and songwriter storytelling at The Pinhook.
events.description: Chris Acker appears with Creekbed Carter Hogan at The Pinhook in Durham on Saturday, July 25, 2026. The show is listed with a 7:00 PM door time at the venue.

events.name: Powell House Band
events.tagline: Free Saturday night indie rock at Slim's Dive Bar.
events.description: Powell House Band is scheduled to play at Slim's Dive Bar in downtown Raleigh on Saturday, July 25, 2026, from 8–11 PM. Listings describe it as a free live music event featuring the local indie rock/pop band Powell House.

events.name: Earlybirds Club
events.tagline: A 6–10 PM dance party for women, trans, and non-binary folks.
events.description: Earlybirds Club is a dance party at Lincoln Theatre in Raleigh designed for women, trans, and non-binary folks. The event runs from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM on Saturday, July 25, 2026.

events.name: Outdoor Couch
events.tagline: Free Saturday afternoon folk-punk at Slim's Dive Bar.
events.description: Outdoor Couch is scheduled to perform at Slim's Dive Bar in downtown Raleigh on Saturday, July 25, 2026, from 3:00 to 5:00 PM. The listing describes the show as free and identifies the venue as Slim's at 227 S. Wilmington St.

events.name: WASTELAND w/ Fallout Steve & DJ Ghost
events.tagline: A Saturday night WASTELAND set at Chapel of Bones.
events.description: WASTELAND featuring Fallout Steve and DJ Ghost is scheduled at Chapel of Bones in Raleigh. The listing shows a Saturday 9 PM start with paid admission.

events.name: Jawbreaker Boxing’s Summer Showdown
events.tagline: An all-ages Saturday boxing event at Jawbreaker Boxing.
events.description: Summer Showdown at Jawbreaker Boxing is an in-person boxing event in Raleigh with doors at 3 PM and the main event running Saturday from 4 to 10 PM. The listing notes free parking and all-ages admission.

events.name: Trailer Park Christmas in July Party
events.tagline: Celebrate Christmas in July with a DJ, holiday vibes, and free admission at Boxcar.
events.description: Christmas came early at Boxcar Bar + Arcade with a Christmas in July party in Durham. Discover Durham lists the event as free admission on Saturday, July 25 at 5:00 PM, with a DJ spinning from 9 PM to midnight.

events.name: Pirates! A Boy At Sea
events.tagline: A swashbuckling family adventure about courage, identity, and treasure.
events.description: Presented by Switch Theater Co., this play follows eleven-year-old Jim Watts as he is swept into a pirate conflict after finding a mysterious treasure chest. The story features battles, wacky pirates, hungry sharks, and magical encounters, and runs through July 25 at The River Church in Durham.

events.name: Holly Springs 150th Anniversary Salamanders Game
events.tagline: Celebrate Holly Springs’ 150th with a special Salamanders home game.
events.description: A special 150th-anniversary Holly Springs Salamanders baseball game is scheduled for Saturday, July 25, 2026, at North Main Athletic Complex. The town’s anniversary calendar notes the festivities begin at 6:30 p.m., and admission is listed at $12.

events.name: Marvel Rivals Online Tournament
events.tagline: An online Marvel Rivals esports tournament hosted by Ego Chall Esports.
events.description: An online tournament for Marvel Rivals hosted by Ego Chall Esports. The provided listing does not include a public in-person schedule or venue street address.

events.name: Read the Room | Stand-Up Comedy
events.tagline: A Saturday night stand-up showcase featuring rising Triangle comics at The ArtsCenter.
events.description: Black Sheep Comedy presents Read the Room, a stand-up comedy showcase at The ArtsCenter in Carrboro. The event is scheduled for Saturday, July 25, 2026, with a 7:00 PM showtime.

events.name: Zebulon Devil Dogz vs. Tri-City Chili Peppers
events.tagline: Coastal Plain League baseball in Zebulon.
events.description: Zebulon Devil Dogz host the Tri-City Chili Peppers in a Coastal Plain League baseball game at Five County Stadium. The matchup is scheduled for Saturday evening in Zebulon.

events.name: Anything Goes!
events.tagline: Cole Porter’s classic musical comedy sails into Hillsborough for a four-show summer run.
events.freeNote: Tickets: Adults $18, Students $15, Seniors $15, Child K–5 $10; ages 4 and under free
events.description: Orange Community Players presents Anything Goes at Orange High School in Hillsborough. Performances run July 23–26, with the Saturday performance at 7:30 PM.

events.name: World Drowning Prevention Day Clinic
events.tagline: Learn hands-on drowning prevention and resuscitation skills at Forest Ridge Park.
events.description: A free 2-hour outdoor clinic led by the American Canoe Association and Rescue Instructor Alliance. Participants will practice drowning prevention and resuscitation techniques at Forest Ridge Park's waterfront, with all equipment provided.

events.name: 2026 Summer Concert Series
events.tagline: Free Sunday evening live music in Fred Fletcher Park.
events.description: The City of Raleigh’s Summer Concert Series offers free Sunday evening performances at Fred Fletcher Park, with all-ages shows running from 6 to 8 p.m. Guests are encouraged to bring a chair or blanket, and performances may be canceled for inclement weather.

events.name: Destin Conrad
events.tagline: R&B singer Destin Conrad brings his tour to The Rialto Theatre.
events.description: Destin Conrad is scheduled to perform at The Rialto Theatre in Midtown Raleigh on Sunday, July 26, 2026. Doors open at 7 PM and the show starts at 8 PM.

events.name: Taste of Soul NC Finale
events.tagline: A free summer food-and-fun festival with live performances and family activities.
events.description: Taste of Soul NC Finale is scheduled for Sunday, July 26, 2026 at City Plaza in downtown Raleigh. The event features local food, desserts, merchandise vendors, kids activities, DJ, live performances, axe throwing, basketball games, and a mini car show.

events.name: Rooted in Time: Living Fossils
events.tagline: A free paleontology talk on living fossils at the Museum of Natural Sciences.
events.description: Join the North Carolina Fossil Club for a presentation by paleontologist Dr. Carole Gee on living fossils. The event is hosted by the North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences at SECU Daily Planet Cafe in downtown Raleigh.

events.name: Durham Underground Market
events.tagline: Free Sunday market with live music, local makers, and food trucks at Durham Central Park.
events.description: Durham Underground Market is a monthly market and concert series at Durham Central Park featuring 50+ local vendors, live music, workshops, and food trucks. In 2026 it runs on seven Sundays from March through November.

events.name: Cocktails & Cuisine Class: Firecracker Sparks Edition
events.tagline: A rooftop cocktail class with bold summer drinks, seasonal bites, and skyline views.
events.description: A high-energy cocktail and cuisine class at The Willard Rooftop Lounge on Sunday, July 26, featuring three playful summer cocktails and seasonal bites. Bartenders guide guests through techniques they can use at home.

events.name: Sunday DRIFT Rooftop DJ Series
events.tagline: Free Sunday rooftop DJ sets at The Velvet Hippo in downtown Durham.
events.description: Sunday DRIFT Rooftop DJ Series is a recurring Sunday rooftop music event at The Velvet Hippo in downtown Durham. The listing shows it runs from 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM and offers free admission.

events.name: Sunday Set with DJ Gemynii
events.tagline: A free rooftop Sunday session with DJ Gemynii, oysters, spritzes, and skyline views.
events.description: Sunday Set with DJ Gemynii is a free rooftop event at The Durham Hotel featuring a DJ set from 5 to 8 PM, along with $2 oysters and a build-your-own spritz bar. The event runs on Sunday, July 26, from 5 to 10 PM and is open to all with no reservations needed.

events.name: SHARK WEEK Hoo Ha Ha
events.tagline: A shark-themed day party at DSSOLVR with cocktails, games, and summer-screening fun.
events.description: Shark Week Hoo Ha Ha is a Shark Week celebration at DSSOLVR in Durham featuring themed cocktails, a photobooth, carnival games, snack bags, and shark week screenings. The event listing shows it as a free, all-day event running during the week of July 26 through August 1.

events.name: Fate & Folklore Presents: Welcome to Camp Dreadful
events.tagline: A spooky camp-themed event at Downtown Durham’s Fate & Folklore.
events.description: Fate & Folklore is a Durham venue at 123B Market Street in Downtown Durham. The event listing is presented as a classes/workshops item on the venue’s website.

events.name: The Cat’s Meow: A Hello Kitty Themed Drag Show
events.tagline: A playful Hello Kitty drag night at Arcana Durham.
events.description: A Hello Kitty-themed drag show scheduled for Sunday at 8:00 PM at Arcana Bar and Lounge in Durham. Eventbrite lists it as a ticketed drag performance.

events.name: Abismo Onix
events.tagline: Dark, heavy live music at Slim's Dive Bar.
events.description: Abismo Onix is listed on Slim's Dive Bar's event archive for a Sunday show in Raleigh. The listing indicates a live-music event at Slim's Dive Bar in downtown Raleigh.

events.name: Oc3ans
events.tagline: An intimate live set at The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop.
events.venue: The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop
